title: Preserve assertion checks across parallel verifier entry points
head: e3b32c0964e2764310f8cf56b141b70c3160c283
body:
The script and snapshot parallel verification entry points inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE. With level 1 or 2, a direct assertion failure and a nested interpreter assertion failure were silently accepted as successful workers. Remove only that variable from their child environments, preserving explicit -O controls and the parent environment.

The repair covers scripts/run_parallel.py and the make descendant environment in scripts/verify_parallel.py together. It also replaces the self-disabling assert __debug__ gate in scripts/verify_complex741_parallel.py with an explicit pre-source-read rejection of -O/-OO. It extends PR1299's registered-replay protection and PR1852's isolated-test protection to the remaining parallel entry points; neither predecessor repaired these two boundaries. PR2035's separate Windows memory-budget scope does not overlap this change.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14: four new real-process regression tests pass, including the actual snapshot/process/failure path (Python substitutes for make); four nearest existing worker/snapshot/input-validation tests and all 15 complex741 scheduler/receipt tests pass. Before the repair the direct/nested failure test failed at both optimization levels because no failures were reported. The fixture delegates cleanup to TemporaryDirectory to isolate a pre-existing Windows read-only Git-object cleanup problem. Full make group suites and selected cold replay were not run.

Task selection: independent-verification / independent-moment, seed 0d5b0c8905ab1ef28729a70870516597, changed explicitly to a verifier failure-propagation audit. Base/current main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4. Fresh open PR title/body overlap checked; Discussion API remains rate-limited, with partial public start-here/handoff snapshots read. No mathematical result or selected-frontier change.

Credit eumemic's PR154 parallel runner lineage, cbethin's PR1299, and woklerx's PR1852. New work by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
